review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed RGB checkpoint tiles before any M3K inference, adjusting projected boxes to visible extents without model predictions.
review.scope: Selected target-checkpoints, not exhaustive labels or independent human certification. Small, dark, crowded and partly truncated objects retained when a visible extent can be assigned. Physical approach labels unchanged; motion is relative to the camera, not a claim that the object itself is moving.

omissions.boreas-m3k-urban-17.3: Distant vehicle is occluded behind foreground car; cannot assign an independent visible extent. Original unknown candidate preserved in candidates.json; omission is not successful abstention.

review.selection: Two intervals selected by pose/cadence metadata before RGB inspection, disjoint from previous study intervals but adjacent in the same recording; not an independent cross-domain population. Labels frozen before development replay.
